questions.prompt: Which 1215 agreement limited the power of an English king?
questions.fact: It was annulled by the pope within ten weeks, yet later reissues embedded it in English law.

questions.prompt: What phenomenon causes the pitch of a passing siren to drop?
questions.fact: The same principle applied to light lets astronomers measure how fast distant galaxies are receding.

questions.prompt: The Haka is performed before matches by teams from which country?
questions.fact: Ka Mate is the best known version, though the national side has used an alternative called Kapa o Pango since 2005.

questions.prompt: Which arcade character is chased through a maze by four coloured ghosts?
questions.fact: Each ghost has distinct chase behaviour, which is why the game feels less random than it first appears.

questions.prompt: Which country is entirely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.fact: It is the only independent state lying wholly above a thousand metres in elevation.

questions.prompt: Which poet wrote 'The Road Not Taken'?
questions.fact: It is widely read as a call to individualism, though the poem itself says the two paths were worn about the same.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the Android operating system?
questions.fact: It was an independent startup building camera software before being acquired in 2005.
